text: The doctor provided excellent consultation and advice. They constantly asked if I was in pain or okay. The doctor was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all. I almost fell asleep but managed to get through it. 😅 The price was good, and the advice was thorough. This clinic is perfect! …

text:
The dentist was so kind and attentive, constantly asking if I was in pain. My first time getting my gums cleaned (tartar removal) was painless! Other clinics never check blood pressure before treatment, but here they do.
The clinic is clean, the dentist is kind and gives thorough advice. After the tartar removal, my gums felt great, there was no bleeding or pain, and my teeth felt clean and refreshed. I love it! It makes me want to go back for more. It gives me motivation to maintain my oral health long-term. I'll go thank the dentist soon. And the treatment costs here aren't expensive either. 👍🏻
